name: Transfer Charge
body:
You can steal power from one magic item to charge another.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to craft a spell-trigger magic item.

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you can cause a magic item with a number of charges in your possession to lose one charge and transfer that charge to another similar item. The item that loses a charge becomes non-functional and cannot be targeted by this feat again for 24 hours.
